prompt: I just installed the design-engineer plugin and I want to set it up for my new SaaS project. It's a project management tool for freelance designers called DesignFlow. I'm working solo, using Figma and Claude Code in the terminal.

assertions.text: Runs environment detection (checks for MCPs, git, existing config)
Asks sequential configuration questions (project type, mode, team size, tools, paths)
Produces a .design-engineer.yaml config file with the user's answers
assertions.check: outputs contain a .design-engineer.yaml or equivalent config

assertions.text: Creates or describes the deliverables folder structure (foundation, research, design, psych, dev, solutions)
Initializes or references the dependency tracking system (.dependencies.yaml)
Provides clear next steps after setup (which command to run next)
Incorporates user context (DesignFlow, SaaS, solo, Figma) into the setup
